name: decentralized-academic-certificate-verification-system
description: Decentralized Academic Certificate Verification System Using Blockchain, Merkle Trees, and IPFS

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix blockchain install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:blockchain" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix blockchain run compile
scripts.test: npm --prefix blockchain run test && npm --prefix server run test
